stemEn: A picture similar to amniotic band sequence was provided with no other abnormality. What will determine the outcome?

options.text: Time of occurrence is what will affect the degree of anomaly
It is a part of an association

explanationAr: في amniotic disruption sequence، نوع وشدة التشوه يعتمدان على توقيت حدوث disruption أثناء embryonic/fetal development وعلى شدة الحدث. لذلك timing هو المفتاح في السؤال.
reasoningEn: The source states that the type of anomaly depends on the developmental stage at which the disruptive event occurs and its severity.
incorrectOptionsAr: اعتبارها association لا يجيب عن العامل الذي يحدد degree/type of anomaly في صياغة المصدر.
clinicalPearl: Earlier amniotic disruption can produce more severe craniofacial/body-wall defects; later disruption more often causes limb constriction or amputation.

stemEn: A 2-month-old male infant is seen for routine well-child evaluation. At birth, his head circumference was below the 5th percentile for age. His head circumference has increased only 1 cm since birth. Which one of the following is the most likely cause of the infant's condition?
explanationAr: لأن head circumference كان صغيرًا منذ الولادة فهذه congenital microcephaly. المصدر يضع first-trimester TORCH infection، ومنها toxoplasmosis، ضمن أسباب congenital microcephaly. أما perinatal asphyxia وIVH والlate infection فتسبب عادة acquired microcephaly بعد ولادة بحجم رأس طبيعي.
reasoningEn: Microcephaly present at birth points to a congenital prenatal cause; the source key is first-trimester toxoplasmosis.
incorrectOptionsAr: IVH وperinatal asphyxia غالبًا acquired/postnatal causes. Third-trimester CMV في framing المصدر يعد late prenatal cause. Craniosynostosis قد يؤدي acquired restriction rather than congenital microcephaly in this vignette.
clinicalPearl: Distinguish congenital from acquired microcephaly by the head circumference at birth and subsequent growth trajectory.

stemEn: A 4-week-old boy is evaluated for macrocephaly. His head circumference is above the 95th percentile, his coronal and sagittal sutures are split by 1 cm, and his fontanelle is bulging. Both parents' head circumferences are above the 95th percentile. What is the most likely explanation for the infant's macrocephaly?
explanationAr: رغم وجود parental macrocephaly، split sutures + bulging fontanelle هما signs of increased intracranial pressure، ولذلك المصدر يختار hydrocephalus بدل benign familial macrocephaly.
reasoningEn: Bulging fontanelle and suture separation indicate raised intracranial pressure, making hydrocephalus the source's best explanation.
incorrectOptionsAr: Familial macrocephaly عادة لا تسبب signs of raised ICP. Achondroplasia قد ترتبط macrocephaly لكن لا تفسر bulging fontanelle/suture separation بهذا الشكل.
clinicalPearl: Macrocephaly with signs of raised intracranial pressure is not simply familial until hydrocephalus is excluded.

stemEn: When is the appropriate time for closure of a cleft palate? A picture was provided.
explanationAr: المصدر يذكر أن cleft lip يُصلح عادةً قرب 10 weeks، بينما palatal cleft closure تُنجز غالبًا بين 9–12 months؛ لذلك الاختيار 9 months.
reasoningEn: The source states that palate closure is usually completed between 9 months and 1 year.
incorrectOptionsAr: 3 أشهر أقرب لتوقيت cleft lip repair في المصدر. 18 شهرًا وسنتان متأخران مقارنةً بالتوقيت المذكور.
clinicalPearl: Timing aims to support speech development while balancing surgical/anatomic considerations.

stemEn: A newborn was noticed to have microtia with no other congenital anomaly. Which investigation should be done next?
explanationAr: Microtia غالبًا تترافق مع external/middle ear malformation وconductive hearing loss؛ لذلك المصدر يقدّم early hearing assessment بـABR كـnext step. ويذكر أيضًا أن renal ultrasound screening موصى به لأن renal anomalies قد تترافق معها، لكنه ليس المفتاح في هذا السؤال.
reasoningEn: The source prioritizes early audiologic assessment with ABR in a newborn with microtia.
incorrectOptionsAr: Renal ultrasound مهم كscreening إضافي حسب المصدر، لكنه ليس answer المختار لـnext step. Echo/genetic study تعتمد على associated anomalies/syndromic suspicion.
clinicalPearl: Microtia evaluation should include early hearing assessment and a careful search for associated anomalies.

stemEn: A picture was provided of an infant with a clenched fist. What will you do next?
explanationAr: المصدر نفسه يضع karyotyping مع علامة استفهام ويقول إن لا توجد features أخرى مذكورة. بما أن clenched fist قد يكون dysmorphic clue لaneuploidy لكن الصورة والـfull phenotype أساسيان، لا نعتمد الجواب قبل ربط الصورة ومراجعتها.
reasoningEn: The source tentatively favors karyotyping, but the recall is incomplete and image-dependent.
incorrectOptionsAr: Brain MRI لا يمكن استبعاده أو اعتباره خطأ بشكل موثوق دون بقية clinical features؛ المصدر لا يقدم شرحًا كافيًا.
clinicalPearl: A single dysmorphic sign should be interpreted in the context of the full phenotype before genetic testing is selected.
